name: Newgrounds
description: Watch Newgrounds movies and listen to Newgrounds audio: featured feed, search, and user channels.
author: Blazeape595692

settings.name: Show author pictures in lists
settings.description: Looks up each author's profile picture for Home, search and recommendations. Turn off to load lists faster.

settings.name: Show rating in titles
settings.description: Puts the age rating in front of movie titles, like [T] or [A]. Audio isn't rated, so it has no tag.

settings.name: Content ratings
settings.description: Which age ratings to show. Applies to movies and games; Newgrounds doesn't rate audio. Adult (A) content is never shown on Home.

settings.name: Show A (Adults only)
settings.description: Adults only. Needs you to be logged in, with adult content turned on in your Newgrounds account settings. In countries with age-verification laws, such as the UK, Newgrounds blocks adult content, so you'll need a VPN set to another country (with Grayjay going through it).
settings.warningDialog:
This shows adults-only content in search, channels, favorites and recommendations (never on Home).

It only works when you're logged in and your Newgrounds account allows adult content.

In countries with age-verification laws, such as the UK, Newgrounds blocks adult content, so you'll need a VPN set to another country (with Grayjay going through it). Otherwise adult videos won't play and their thumbnails stay blank.
